prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a short swept-up crown of sharp cropped spikes with closely tapered sides and an exposed nape; costume silhouette a razor-shouldered sleek corporate suit with a high collar and thin glowing seams — an upright, cold silhouette; design idea A narrow white bridge-mast blade is built into the high suit collar; jacaranda-violet quilting becomes slim inset pneumatic channels in the fitted suit seams, and the bridge pivot becomes the compact waist clasp. The declared fitted corporate silhouette takes precedence: keep its narrow tailored profile and do not add a separate bulky jacket.; face a bold, self-assured confidence — a direct, steady gaze, oval face, ice-blue eyes; expression a composed direct gaze with relaxed closed lips.
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Argentine woman — the personification of the city of Buenos Aires — one woman who IS Buenos Aires as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a bold, self-assured confidence — a direct, steady gaze; bronze-brown skin; oval face; softly deep-set eyes of natural size; ice-blue eyes; brows with a clean, angled peak; a nose with a soft, rounded tip, of natural size; slender lips of natural width.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist build; a short swept-up crown of sharp cropped spikes with closely tapered sides and an exposed nape; glossy jet-black hair.
Expression: a composed direct gaze with relaxed closed lips.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: an oversized padded jacket quilted in jacaranda violet whose little vents breathe out soft glowing wisps of clean air, and a single white fin-like collar rising from one shoulder and leaning back like the swept mast of the turning footbridge.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a razor-shouldered sleek corporate suit with a high collar and thin glowing seams — an upright, cold silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: A narrow white bridge-mast blade is built into the high suit collar; jacaranda-violet quilting becomes slim inset pneumatic channels in the fitted suit seams, and the bridge pivot becomes the compact waist clasp. The declared fitted corporate silhouette takes precedence: keep its narrow tailored profile and do not add a separate bulky jacket.
Colours: tango wine red, jacaranda violet, river-of-silver grey — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a polished calabash mate gourd banded in silver with a slim silver drinking straw, a thin curl of softly glowing steam rising from it; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a far-future river city spread along a vast silver-brown estuary two centuries on, at dusk: the old dock basins have become long mirror-still canals lined with slender glass towers and restored old warehouses glowing amber; a white footbridge with a single tall swept-back mast turns slowly on its pivot to let a silent boat glide through; on the widest avenue in the world a slender white obelisk stands among rivers of light, the avenue's broad middle grown into a long violet ribbon of jacaranda trees; tall air-gardens of living green climb the towers and breathe out softly glowing mist, filling the city with the clean, good air of its name, while quiet flying vehicles drift over the river.
This card: on the white turning footbridge over the mirror-still dock canal at dusk, its tall swept-back mast leaning above her as the span swings open and glass towers glow along the water.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: standing upright with feet parallel, mate gourd held just below her chest and the other arm naturally straight at her side.
Setting detail: a low glass parapet with silver canal reflections, distant vertical air-gardens and a diagonally receding bridge deck.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
